title: Lead Salesforce Engineer
description:
The IT SaaS Engineering Team plays a critical role in enabling MongoDB’s post\-sales business processes, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows. By leveraging Salesforce and related business systems, the team ensures that post\-sales teams have the tools, automation, security, and governance needed to effectively manage customer relationships, support customer outcomes, improve operational efficiency, and drive long\-term customer growth.
   

  

 With deep expertise in Salesforce development, platform governance, automation, integrations, and system operations, the team continuously enhances the CRM platform to support evolving post\-sales business needs. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Customer Success, Technical Services, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Billing, Security, Compliance, and Engineering to deliver scalable, secure, and reliable Salesforce solutions.
   

  

 We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are looking for a highly experienced Lead Salesforce Engineer to drive the architecture, design, and evolution of critical Salesforce and CRM solutions supporting MongoDB’s post\-sales business processes. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands\-on solution design, cross\-functional stakeholder partnership, people management, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI\-powered development responsibly to improve productivity, quality, and long\-term platform health.
   

  

 The ideal candidate will have strong experience designing scalable Salesforce solutions for complex customer lifecycle processes, including customer success operations, support workflows, renewals, account management, customer health, and post\-sales automation.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Lead the architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions supporting post\-sales teams, including Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, and account management workflows
* Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, and scalable technical solutions aligned with long\-term platform strategy
* Partner closely with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering teams to refine requirements and deliver high\-quality post\-sales solutions
* Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design across the customer lifecycle
* Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, maintainability, and governance
* Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management
* Troubleshoot complex technical and production issues and drive long\-term, scalable resolutions
* Maintain technical documentation, including architecture decisions, design specifications, and implementation details
* Stay current with Salesforce platform capabilities, releases, and best practices, and proactively recommend improvements
* Proactively identify process and technical gaps, and help define and drive tech debt reduction initiatives, platform modernization efforts, and engineering efficiency improvements across the Salesforce ecosystem
* Leverage AI\-powered engineering tools such as Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce/Vibes, Claude Code, and similar capabilities to improve development productivity, code quality, design effectiveness, troubleshooting, and documentation, while applying strong judgment around security, privacy, accuracy, and responsible AI usage


**Responsibilities**
* Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices
* Act as a subject matter expert on Salesforce development, platform capabilities, automation, integrations, and scalable CRM solution design for post\-sales business processes
* Lead technical design sessions and identify gaps between current\-state and future\-state solutions
* Design and support scalable solutions for customer success, support operations, renewals, customer health, account management, and related post\-sales workflows
* Evaluate emerging technologies, frameworks, and engineering practices, and drive proof\-of\-concepts where appropriate
* Mentor engineers across the team and foster a culture of ownership, collaboration, continuous learning, and engineering excellence
* Support team growth by coaching, developing talent, and helping build a high\-performing engineering organization
* Influence business and technical stakeholders through strong communication, sound judgment, and effective problem\-solving
* Operate effectively in a fast\-changing environment by managing priorities, driving accountability, and ensuring high\-quality execution


**Minimum Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* 12\+ years of experience in Salesforce engineering, application development, or technical leadership within global SaaS organizations
* Strong hands\-on experience with Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, integrations, and Salesforce platform customization
* Strong understanding of Salesforce architecture, governor limits, design patterns, and scalable solution design
* Experience designing or supporting Salesforce solutions for post\-sales functions such as Customer Success, Support, Renewals, Services, or customer lifecycle management
* Experience with DevOps, CI/CD, release management, and Agile/Scrum delivery models
* Salesforce Platform Developer II certification required; Salesforce Certified Application Architect and Salesforce Certified System Architect certifications strongly preferred


 Success Measures
   

  

 In 3 months, you will
   

  

 Develop a strong understanding of MongoDB’s Salesforce ecosystem, post\-sales business processes, and technical landscape. Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders across Customer Success, Support, Revenue Operations, and Engineering.
   

  

 In 6 months, you will
   

  

 Lead the technical design and successful delivery of critical Salesforce initiatives supporting post\-sales workflows. Establish yourself as a trusted technical leader within the Business Systems team.
   

  

 In 12 months, you will
   

  

 Be the go\-to technical leader for Salesforce architecture, complex solution design, and platform strategy for post\-sales systems. Elevate team quality through strong technical leadership, mentoring, and scalable engineering practices
   

  

**About MongoDB**
 MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud\-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi\-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
   

  

 With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including 75% of the Fortune 100 and AI\-native startups, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
   

  

 Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
   

  

 To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!

 **Application \& Enterprise Architecture (A\&EA)** 
 organization provides the architectural leadership and governance needed to design, evolve, and simplify Synchrony’s technology landscape. A\&EA partners with product, engineering, security, data, and infrastructure teams to ensure that solutions are
 **business\-aligned, scalable, secure, resilient, and cost\-effective** 
 , while reducing complexity and accelerating delivery.
   

  

**Role Summary/Purpose**
 The
 **AVP, Senior Product Engineer** 
 is responsible for administering, supporting, troubleshooting, and optimizing SAS Viya environments deployed on AWS and Kubernetes (Amazon EKS). This role requires strong expertise in SAS Viya platform administration, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes operations, Terraform\-based infrastructure as code, security, authentication, and enterprise system integrations.
   

  

 The position plays a critical role in ensuring platform stability, performance, scalability, and security while supporting modernization and migration initiatives from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.0\. The administrator will collaborate closely with infrastructure, security, IAM, network, database, and application teams to deliver reliable enterprise analytics platform services.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 The role involves end\-to\-end operational ownership of SAS Viya 4 environments and associated AWS and Kubernetes infrastructure components.
   

  

* Administer and support SAS Viya 4 environments in enterprise production settings.
* Perform platform configuration, upgrades, patching, monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing maintenance.
* Manage SAS Viya services, compute environments, CAS, SAS Studio, users, groups, roles, and authorization controls.
* Troubleshoot application, compute, storage, and performance issues within SAS Viya.
* Support and manage SAS Viya deployments on Kubernetes and Amazon EKS.
* Investigate and resolve issues related to pods, deployments, services, persistent volumes, storage, nodes, resource limits, and application logs.
* Configure and troubleshoot integrations between SAS Viya and AWS services including EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, and VPC components.
* Manage IAM roles, policies, service accounts, permissions, and cross\-account accessrequirements.
* Develop, maintain, and troubleshoot Terraform\-based infrastructure as code for cloud resources and platform deployments.
* Create and manage Terraform modules, variables, plans, state files, and deployment workflows.
* Configure and support enterprise authentication and SSO integrations using Okta, SAML, LDAP/Active Directory, OAuth/OIDC, or similar technologies.
* Troubleshoot authentication, MFA, authorization, SSO, and role\-mapping issues.
* Support platform security requirements including certificates, TLS/SSL, networking, and connectivity.
* Perform performance tuning, capacity planning, and optimization across CPU, memory, storage, and I/O layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Terraform, Python, Shell, and SAS scripting.
* Support migration activities from SAS 9\.4/Grid to SAS Viya 4\.
* Collaborate with AWS, Security, IAM, Network, Database, and Application teams to ensure seamless platform operations.


**Required Skills/Knowledge**
 Candidates must demonstrate strong technical depth across SAS Viya administration, cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and infrastructure automation.
   

  

* 6\+ years of experience in SAS Administration.
* Hands\-on experience administering SAS Viya 4 environments.
* Strong experience with AWS services such as EC2, RDS, S3, IAM, STS, EKS, S3, Lambda and VPC.
* Strong understanding of Kubernetes concepts including Pods, Deployments, Services, ConfigMaps, Secrets, PVC/PV, Storage Classes, and resource management.
* Hands\-on experience with Amazon EKS.
* Hands\-on experience with Terraform and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* Experience with enterprise authentication technologies such as Okta, SAML, OAuth, SSO, MFA, or equivalent solutions.
* Knowledge of LDAP/Active Directory and role\-based access control.
* Linux administration and troubleshooting experience.
* Experience with SAS Viya monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
* Experience with Python and Shell scripting for automation.


**Desired Skills/Knowledge**
 The ideal candidate will bring a combination of strong technical capability, operational discipline, and collaboration skills to support a modern enterprise analytics platform.
   

  

* Experience with SAS 9\.4 Grid/SAS Viya 4 administration.
* SAS Viya or AWS certification.
* Exposure to Helm, Ansible, Jenkins, Git, or CI/CD tools and practices.
* Experience with AWS Glue, Redshift, Snowflake, or other cloud data platforms.
* Experience supporting enterprise production environments and cloud migration projects.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to work effectively across cross\-functional teams in infrastructure, security, and application domains.
* Proactive approach to automation, optimization, and operational improvement.
* Strong communication and documentation skills.


**Eligibility Criteria**
* 6\-10 Years of Total experience, 3\-4 years of SAS Viya Administration, and 2\-3 years of AWS experience, having hood hands\-on and knowledge in Terraform/DevOps/Jenkins.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
**What is Hunch?**
 Hunch is a dating app built for follow\-through \- designed to turn mutual interest into a real first date instead of another chat thread that fizzles out. Built for people tired of mindless swiping and commodified matchmaking, Hunch uses an AI matchmaker to cut the week of back\-and\-forth and get two interested people out of the app and into the same room.
   

  

 With 2\.4M\+ daters, 1\.47M\+ dates planned, and 100% photo\-verified profiles, Hunch is growing fast in the US by challenging the swipe\-left/right norm of traditional apps. Hunch is a Series A funded ($23 Million) startup building the future of social discovery in a post\-AI world.
   

  

 Link to our fundraising announcement
   

  

**Key Offerings Of Hunch**
* One Drop a Day: A small, hand\-picked set of photo\-verified profiles arrives daily \- chosen for taste, lifestyle, and who's actually free to meet. So every profile gets real attention instead of a mindless swipe.
* Interest Becomes a Plan: When both people want to meet, Hunch's AI matchmaker turns mutual interest into a confirmed date with a real time and place \- no logistics to manage.
* Every Match, Verified: Every profile is matched to a live photo before it appears in anyone's drop. No bots, no catfishing \- just real, trustworthy connections.
* Built to Move: Chats close after seven days and users hold a few conversations at a time \- nudges designed to get people out the door, not scrolling forever.


**About The Role**
 We're on the lookout for a SDE\-III to join our lean, dynamic team as we scale. We believe in pushing boundaries, challenging the status quo, and embracing diversity of thought. You'll be building fast, smart, and with purpose — and we're looking for someone who can lead that charge both technically and culturally.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own backend features end\-to\-end — product problem to API, schema, migration, tests, and deployment. You solve the problem, not just the ticket.
* Build and run services across both stacks: TypeScript (Bun/Node, Prisma, Next.js) and Python (FastAPI, Pydantic, SQLAlchemy).
* Own async \& event\-driven work — queues, streaming ingestion, scheduled jobs, retries, and idempotency. (A lot of our load never touches a request handler.)
* Ship LLM\-backed product features — tool calling, structured outputs, grounding against real data, and the failure handling that keeps them sane in front of users.
* Keep production legible — tracing, metrics, and alerts that fire only when action is needed. You own your deploys and their consequences.


**What You'll Bring**
* 5\+ years building and running backend systems in production. You've been on the hook when things broke.
* Dual\-stack proficiency: TypeScript/Node \+ Python — strong in one, genuinely productive in the other. This isn't a "Python nice\-to\-have" role.
* Relational databases at depth: Postgres or MySQL — schema design, migrations, indexing, and reading query plans to fix the slow ones.
* Streaming/event infrastructure in production: Kinesis or Kafka — producers, consumers, partitioning, replay, and handling backpressure and duplicates.
* Service design \& delivery — clean contracts, sensible boundaries, and knowing when not to split a service. Hands\-on with AWS, Docker, and CI/CD.
* End\-to\-end ownership — you've carried features from idea to production and lived with the results. Founding or product\-engineer experience is a huge plus.
* Engineering hygiene — writing tests with the change (not after), disciplined releases, and caring whether the metric actually moved.


**Preferred Experience**
* ML Platform: Serving models behind APIs, vector retrieval (pgvector/FAISS), feature pipelines, and model versioning/rollout. Keeping models alive in production counts double.
* LLM Application Engineering: Agent loops, tool calling, structured output, and evaluating output quality programmatically. Self\-hosted inference (vLLM, GPU serving, cost tuning) is a strong plus.
* Data at Scale: Redshift/BigQuery/Snowflake, and observability tools (OpenTelemetry, Datadog).
* Experimentation: A/B and shadow tests, guardrail metrics, and the discipline to read a flat result honestly.
* Domain Experience: Consumer social or dating products.


**What We Offer**
* Competitive pay along with an annual performance\-linked incentive (PLI).
* Employee benefits like Medical Insurance.
* Participation in Employee Phantom Grants Program (Stock Options).


**Life at Hunch**
 Hunch is a small team focused on shipping the parts of dating that usually stall \- getting two interested people into the same room.
   

  

**What We Hire For \- The ABCs**
 Most companies have a long list of values nobody remembers. We have three, and they show up in how we hire, what we ship, and how we talk about the work:
   

  

* Authenticity \- Real before polished. We build for real people on real first dates, and we hire the same way. No theater. If something's not working, say so; if it is, ship it.
* Boldness \- Dating got stuck because nobody wanted to break the pattern. We make the call on what to ship, what to cut, and what doesn't belong in the product, even when it's the harder choice.
* Curiosity \- The best people here ask a lot of small, useful questions — about users, about the data, about each other's work. We trust people who keep learning over people who already know.


**How We Work**
* Ownership, not theater \- You own outcomes, not status updates. Fewer meetings, fewer dashboards, more shipping.
* Flexibility that's real \- We care about the work, not the hours you sit at a desk. Take the afternoon, take the week \- show up for the stuff that matters.
* Move fast, don't burn out \- Hunch ships quickly because we cut the slow stuff, not because we work people into the ground. Velocity comes from focus, not from hours.
* Small team, big problems \- You'll work on things that matter to millions of people trying to actually meet someone. Every role moves the product.


**Backed by Global Investors**
 Hunch is backed by Hashed, AlphaWave, Brevan Howard and Polygon Studios.
   

  

**Experienced Leadership**
 Hunch is founded by a trio of industry veterans: Ish Goel (CEO), Nitika Goel (CPO), and Kartic Rakhra (CMO) \- serial entrepreneurs with their last exit from Nexus Mutual, a web3 consumer\-tech startup.

title: IT Manager -Software Engineering
description:
**About AutoZone**
 AutoZone is the nation's leading retailer and a leading distributor of automotive replacement parts and accessories with more than 6,000 stores in the US, Puerto Rico, Mexico, and Brazil. Each store carries an extensive line of cars, sport utility vehicles, vans, and light trucks, including new and remanufactured hard parts, maintenance items, and accessories.
   

  

 We also sell automotive diagnostic and repair software through ALLDATA, diagnostic and repair information through ALLDATAdiy.com, automotive accessories through AutoAnything.com, and auto and light truck parts and accessories through AutoZone.com.

 AutoZone has been committed to providing the best parts, prices, and customer service in the automotive aftermarket industry. We have a rich culture and history of going the Extra Mile for our customers and our community. At AutoZone you’re not just doing a job; you’re playing a crucial role in creating a better experience for our customers while creating opportunities to DRIVE YOUR CAREER almost anywhere! We are looking for talented, customer\-focused people, enjoy helping others, and have the DRIVE to excel in a fast\-paced environment!
   

  

 Position Summary
   

  

 The Technical Manager is a hands\-on technical leader responsible for leading software engineering teams that design, build, modernize, and operate AutoZone’s global data platform. This role balances
 **technical depth, people leadership, and delivery execution** 
 , ensuring that cloud\-native, secure, and scalable solutions are delivered on Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
   

  

 The Technical Manager partners closely with architects, product managers, security, and business stakeholders to translate architectural vision into high\-quality execution. This role is accountable for engineering excellence, team development, and consistent delivery of reliable, secure, and performant software products that support AutoZone’s growth and global expansion.
   

  

* Lead and oversee the design of robust ETL pipelines ensuring data reliability and accuracy.
* Implement monitoring and alerting of data pipelines to track data quality and data freshness.
* Lead a team of software engineers in the development of data services layer.
* Experience with data engineering pipelines using Big Query as the data platform,
* Ensure consistent application of engineering best practices, including CI/CD pipelines, containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/GKE), automated testing, and deployment strategies.
* Own delivery commitments for team initiatives, ensuring predictable execution, high quality, and on\-time delivery using Agile and DevOps methodologies.
* Collaborate with InfoSec and compliance teams to ensure security, privacy, and regulatory requirements (GDPR, LGPD, etc.) are embedded into software development and operational processes.
* Conduct and participate in code reviews, design reviews, and architectural discussions to ensure technical quality and adherence to standards.
* Work closely with product management and business leaders to translate requirements into actionable technical plans and incremental delivery milestones.
* Monitor and improve system performance, reliability, and operational health across production environments.


**People \& Leadership Responsibilities**
* Directly manage, mentor, and develop engineers and technical leads, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Support career development through regular feedback, coaching, and performance management aligned with company values and engineering expectations.
* Promote adoption of modern development practices, engineering discipline, and a strong quality mindset across teams.
* Act as an escalation point for technical and delivery issues, driving timely resolution while maintaining team morale and focus.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science or equivalent practical experience.
* 15\+ years of professional software development experience, including leadership of data platforms.
* 5\+ years of experience leading or managing data engineering teams.
* Solid back\-end development experience using Java (Spring Boot) and Data Management tools.
* Experience designing and working with relational databases (MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL) and NoSQL databases (MongoDB).
* Experience in developing ETL pipelines and data governance.
* Experience in Agentic AI development.
* Practical experience with cloud\-native development on Google Cloud Platform, including services such as GKE, Cloud SQL, Pub/Sub, Apigee, and data platforms.
* Experience with CI/CD tools (GitLab, Jenkins, ArgoCD), containerization, and Kubernetes\-based deployments.
* Strong understanding of security, privacy, and compliance considerations for SaaS platforms.

title: AI Agent Engineer
description:
**About Manifest Global**
 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility \- connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans
 **Cialfo** 
 (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools),
 **BridgeU** 
 (university guidance for international schools globally),
 **Kaaiser** 
 (trusted study abroad counseling across India and Southeast Asia), and
 **Explore** 
 (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 What This Role Is
   

 AI agents — systems that reason, plan, take action across tools, and complete real work end\-to\-end — have moved from research demos to production infrastructure in the last eighteen months. The companies that build them well will define the next decade of what software is and what people do.
   

 Manifest Global sits at one of the most operationally complex intersections in the world. Every day, our platforms move students between continents, counselors between conversations, applications between deadlines, universities between recruiting cycles, and agents between thousands of families making generational decisions. The work is high\-stakes, high\-volume, and full of judgment calls — exactly the kind of work that breaks under brittle automation and exactly the kind of work AI agents, built properly, can transform.
   

 That is the bet behind this role. Not chatbots. Not wrappers. Agents that actually do the work — drafting university shortlists with reasoning a counselor would defend, surfacing the right student profile to the right admissions officer, catching the document that's about to make an application fail before a human sees it. Agents that hold context across long workflows. Agents that know when to escalate and when to keep going. Agents that get measurably better as more of the network uses them.
   

 You will build those agents across the Manifest portfolio, in production, at a scale that matters.
   

 What Makes This Role Different
   

 Most companies hiring AI agent builders right now have one of two problems. They have the data but no real product surface to deploy into, so the agents sit in demos waiting for distribution. Or they have the distribution but the underlying data is too fragmented to support agents that work in production. Manifest has both. Cialfo's 2,000\+ schools, BridgeU's international school footprint, Kaaiser's three decades of placement data, Explore's 1,000\+ universities — that is the substrate. Saige, already live inside Cialfo, is proof that AI in this domain works when it is built well. Your job is to extend that surface across the portfolio.
   

 This is not a research role. The agents you build will be used by real counselors, students, admissions officers, and partners within weeks of being shipped, not quarters. The feedback loop is tight. The accountability is direct. If an agent you built makes a bad shortlist, a counselor will tell you the same week. That is the speed at which good AI products get built right now, and it is the speed this role operates at.
   

 The broader EdTech market is contracting. Manifest is growing. AI is the lever — and the people who build the agents will define what the next version of this company looks like.
   

 What You Own
   

**The agent platform**
* Design and build production AI agents across Manifest's brands, starting with the highest\-leverage workflows in counseling, admissions outreach, and operational triage
* Own the architecture decisions: model selection, tool use, memory, evaluation, guardrails, and the orchestration layer that holds it together
* Build the abstractions that turn one good agent into a platform


**Evaluation and reliability**
* Define what "working" means for each agent in measurable terms, and build the evaluation infrastructure that proves it
* Own latency, cost, and accuracy as engineering disciplines, not afterthoughts
* Build the safety layer: when an agent should stop, when it should escalate, when it should ask


**Integration into product**
* Work directly with product and engineering teams across Cialfo, BridgeU, Kaaiser, and Explore to ship agents into the surfaces where users already are
* Translate fuzzy user problems into agent specifications that can actually be built
* Close the loop between user feedback and model behaviour faster than anyone in this industry currently does


**Technical direction**
* Set the standard for how AI agents are built at Manifest — tooling, frameworks, model providers, evaluation harness, deployment patterns
* Stay close enough to the research frontier to know what is becoming possible six months out, and ship accordingly


 What Success Looks Like
   

* The markers below reflect where Manifest's AI agent function is today. We'll calibrate the specifics once you're in the seat. These are directional, not fixed.
* In the first weeks, you have a clear point of view on which workflows across the portfolio are the highest\-leverage places to deploy agents — and you can defend that view to the counselors, product leaders, and engineers who will use what you build. You have started building, not just planning. Something is in the hands of a real user by the end of month three.
* By mid\-period, at least one agent you have built is in production, used daily, and measurably better than the manual workflow it replaced. The evaluation infrastructure exists and is trusted by the people whose work depends on it. Other engineers across the group know how to build agents the Manifest way because you have made that pattern legible.
* Longer term, the agent layer is infrastructure, not a project. New product surfaces ship with AI agents as a default, not an exception. The work you built outlasts the specific models you started with, because the architecture you chose absorbed model upgrades without rewriting from scratch. The specifics will be calibrated once you're in the role. The direction won't change.


 What You Bring
   

* You have spent the better part of your career building software that runs in production — and somewhere in the last two years, you became one of the people other engineers go to when they have a hard question about LLMs, agents, or how to actually make this stuff work outside a notebook. You have shipped something agentic. Not a prototype. Something users use.
* You know the current frontier well enough to be opinionated about it. You have working views on which model providers to use for what, which orchestration patterns hold up under real load, where the abstractions in popular agent frameworks leak, and how to evaluate something that doesn't have a single correct answer. You write production\-quality Python. You are comfortable with the surrounding stack: vector stores, prompt management, evaluation frameworks, observability tooling.
* You think in systems, not in prompts. When you see a workflow, you instinctively map where reasoning happens, where state lives, where tools get called, where humans need to stay in the loop. You build for the model that ships in six months, not the one that exists today.
* You are self\-directed in the way this kind of role requires. There is no finished playbook for what you are building. The questions you will face — which agent to build next, how much to invest in evaluation infrastructure, when to use a smaller model and when to use a frontier one — will not have obvious answers. You make calls, you ship, you learn, you adjust.
* Somewhere underneath the technical depth, you care about what the agents you build actually do in the world. The fact that a student in Delhi or Manila or Lagos is going to make a better university decision because of code you wrote — that matters to you.
* Most importantly, you read the description of what Manifest is building in AI and your first reaction was the agents I want to build are exactly the ones this company needs built. That's the person this role is for.


 Why Manifest
   

 Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility — connecting students, schools, universities, and employers across 50\+ countries. Our portfolio spans Cialfo (AI\-powered college counseling, 2,000\+ schools), BridgeU (university guidance for international schools globally), Kaaiser (trusted study abroad counseling since 1997 across India and Southeast Asia), and Explore (AI\-powered university outreach, 1,000\+ university partners). Together, we move talent across borders at scale. $700B flows annually in remittances from migrant workers. 85M workers will be missing from developed economies by 2030\. We're building the operating system which changes that. $80M raised. Still early.
   

 For this role specifically, the AI agents you build are not adjacent to the mission — they are the mission's primary lever. Counselors cannot serve every student who needs guidance. Universities cannot manually reach every qualified applicant. Operations teams cannot manually track every application across every destination. The only way the infrastructure we are building reaches the scale the problem actually demands is through AI agents that hold their own in real work. That is what this seat is for.
   

*Manifest Global is building the infrastructure for global human capital mobility, operating across 50\+ countries.*

title: Senior Partner Solution Engineer
description:
At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI\-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high\-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low\-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast\-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done.
   

  

 Snowflake is about empowering enterprises to achieve their full potential — and people too. With a culture that’s all in on impact, innovation, and collaboration, Snowflake is the sweet spot for building big, moving fast, and taking technology — and careers — to the next level.
   

  

 We’re at the forefront of the data revolution, committed to building the world’s greatest data and applications platform. Our ‘get it done’ culture allows everyone at Snowflake to have an equal opportunity to innovate on new ideas, create work with a lasting impact, and excel in a culture of collaboration.
   

  

 Snowflake partners, from System Integrators (SI), Cloud Service Providers (CSP) and Technology Partners (ISV) are an integral part of Snowflake business to help customers unlock Power of Snowflake AI Data Cloud.
   

  

 We are seeking a highly motivated and proactive individual to drive the technical growth in this Partner ecosystem.
   

  

 This role demands a technical expert capable of driving success by aligning with key programs and significantly enhancing partner knowledge of crucial product features. The candidate must effectively present to both technical and executive audiences, utilising methods from whiteboarding to presentations and demonstrations, to cultivating strong mind share among Snowflake Partners across India.
   

  

 We require a candidate with a demonstrable history of successful engagement with major partners and a proven ability to develop technical champions within their organisations. Ideal candidates will possess a deep understanding of the broader Platform ecosystem, including products and the competitive landscape, enabling them to influence and serve as the partners' trusted technical advisor.
   

  

 This role requires travel up to 50% within India throughout the quarter to support partner engagement such as enablement, deal support and marketing events.

 Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.
   

  

 How do you want to make your impact?

title: Sustaining Engineer
description:
For over four decades, PAR Technology Corporation (NYSE: PAR) has been a leader in restaurant technology, empowering brands worldwide to create lasting connections with their guests. Our innovative solutions and commitment to excellence provide comprehensive software and hardware that enable seamless experiences and drive growth for over 100,000 restaurants in more than 110 countries. Embracing our "Better Together" ethos, we offer Unified Customer Experience solutions, combining point\-of\-sale, digital ordering, loyalty and back\-office software solutions as well as industry\-leading hardware and drive\-thru offerings. To learn more, visit partech.com or connect with us on LinkedIn, X (formerly Twitter), Facebook, and Instagram.
   

  

 PAR is seeking a highly skilled Sustaining Engineer to join the technical backbone of the Punchh platform. This engineering\-led role ensures the health, stability, and scalability of Punchh's production systems, supporting the restaurant brands and their guests who rely on it every day.
   

  

 You will be hands\-on in resolving complex production issues at the code level, conducting root cause analysis, and implementing architectural and process improvements to meet service\-level objectives (SLOs) and service\-level agreements (SLAs). You will work closely with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Customer Success teams, and your findings will regularly be communicated onward to the restaurant brands we serve.
   

  

 Please note: this role requires sustained working overlap with North America business hours, and includes ownership of recurring daily and weekly operational duties described below. Please read the "How This Role Actually Works" section carefully before applying.
   

  

**Unleash Your Potential**
 Punchh Is a Customer Loyalty And Engagement Platform For Restaurant Brands. The Majority Of The Issues You Will Investigate Fall Into These Areas
   

  

* Loyalty campaigns — segmentation, mass gifting, recall and anniversary campaigns, scheduled sends, control groups, and campaign performance reporting.
* Loyalty mechanics — points earning and expiry, redeemables, rewards balances, tiers, and guest\-level data integrity.
* Integrations — POS systems, online ordering providers, payment processors, and marketing/messaging platforms.
* Platform reliability — database performance under campaign load, notification delivery, API availability, and authentication flows.


 Prior experience in loyalty, marketing automation, or restaurant technology is a significant advantage. Candidates whose background is purely generic backend or infrastructure work, without exposure to campaign or customer\-data platforms, will find the ramp steeper.
   

  

**How This Role Actually Works**
 Beyond project and escalation work, this role carries standing operational ownership. We want to be explicit about this, because it is a meaningful part of the week:
   

  

* Daily monitoring and reporting — you will own the daily campaign load report and a forward\-looking overload forecast covering multiple production stacks, and publish it to the engineering team each morning.
* Alert triage ownership — you will be the first responder for automated alerts across campaign, worker SLO, and application error channels. Engineers and product teams will tag you directly and rely on your judgment to distinguish a genuine failure from expected noise.
* Weekly operational communications — production maintenance summaries and technical updates for the Customer Success team.
* Remediation execution — running and validating data\-fix and bulk\-gifting scripts against live production data, often affecting thousands to hundreds of thousands of guest records, with appropriate care, checkpointing, and verification.


 These duties do not stop when a project is busy. Reliability here comes from someone doing the unglamorous things consistently.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

 Engineering\-Led Issue Resolution
   

  

* Act as the final escalation point for complex, cross\-system production issues impacting integrations or customer\-facing features.
* Lead incident bridges for high\-severity events, acting as technical incident commander and driving timely root cause analysis (RCA), postmortems, and recovery.
* Investigate campaign and loyalty defects end to end — from a brand's report through segment, scheduling, delivery, and reporting layers — to a defensible root cause.


 Code\-Level Debugging \& Platform Stewardship
   

  

* Perform deep root cause analysis across APIs, integrations, and microservices using logs, telemetry, SQL queries, and source\-level debugging.
* Contribute directly to the codebase with fixes, refactors, and stability improvements, collaborating with development teams for safe rollouts.
* Maintain a comprehensive understanding of Punchh's platform architecture, data flows, and infrastructure to support ongoing reliability efforts.


 Data Remediation \& Script Execution
   

  

* Design, review, and execute remediation scripts to correct guest\-level data — missed gifting, incorrect point balances, duplicate transactions, and reward corrections.
* Validate scope and counts before execution and verify results afterwards; work within platform constraints such as job runtime limits using checkpointing and resumable approaches.
* Exercise appropriate caution and secure sign\-off before any operation that modifies production guest data at scale.


**Technical Leadership for Integrations**
* Serve as the engineering lead for third\-party integrations (POS, online ordering, payment processors, marketing platforms), ensuring compliance, reliability, and quality.
* Validate and certify partner integrations through code review, API validation (leveraging Postman where appropriate), and architecture alignment.
* Define and enforce integration best practices and standards across the platform ecosystem.


 Operational Excellence, ITIL \& Automation
   

  

* Leverage Databricks for scheduled job analysis, performance tuning, and large\-scale data troubleshooting.
* Use New Relic and other observability tools to monitor application health, detect anomalies, and proactively identify system issues.
* Maintain and evolve technical runbooks, diagnostic playbooks, and integration guidelines to reduce future escalations.
* Apply ITIL best practices for incident, problem, and change management to improve process consistency.
* Identify opportunities to automate triage, alerting, and recovery workflows, reducing manual effort and improving mean\-time\-to\-recovery (MTTR).


**Brand\-Facing Technical Communication**
 A distinctive part of this role: technical findings frequently need to reach the restaurant brands we serve. You will be expected to:
   

  

* Translate technical root causes into clear, accurate explanations that Customer Success can take to a brand — including drafting the customer\-facing wording.
* Be precise about what is known, what is not known, and what cannot be determined, rather than over\-claiming under pressure.
* Distinguish clearly between platform defects, configuration issues on the brand's side, and expected behavior — and communicate that distinction diplomatically.
* Contribute to formal RCA documents delivered to brands following significant incidents.


**Cross\-Functional Collaboration \& Knowledge Sharing**
* Collaborate with Engineering, Product, DevOps, and Customer Success teams to identify systemic trends and implement platform\-level improvements.
* Represent Sustaining Engineering in release planning, readiness reviews, and go\-live support.
* Mentor Tier 2 teams, share knowledge, and help build organizational capability to reduce escalations over time.


**What We Are Looking For**
**Technical Expertise**
* 5\+ years in sustaining engineering, production support, or backend development in SaaS or platform environments.
* Strong Ruby on Rails experience — the Punchh platform is Rails\-based, and code\-level debugging in Rails is central to this role.
* Strong SQL skills — able to write and optimize queries independently for investigation, impact analysis, and root cause work.
* Advanced experience troubleshooting distributed systems, microservices, and public cloud (AWS preferred).
* Proficiency with RESTful APIs, authentication (OAuth 2\.0, JWT), and webhooks.
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP), including services such as Lambda, API Gateway, S3, and DynamoDB.
* Skilled in debugging JSON/XML payloads, API logs, and mobile SDK integrations (iOS/Android push notifications).
* Familiarity with SPA frameworks (React, Angular, Vue), networking (DNS, TLS/SSL, VPNs), and security protocols (PCI DSS).
* Understanding of DevOps processes and CI/CD pipelines to support seamless deployments and rollback strategies.
* Understanding of SRE practices, including SLO tracking, error budgets, and postmortem culture.
* Databricks — running scheduled jobs, analyzing large data sets, and troubleshooting performance issues.
* New Relic and comparable observability tooling (Datadog, CloudWatch, Sentry) — monitoring, alerting, and performance analysis.
* Postman — API testing, automation, and validation of integrations.
* Jira or equivalent — managing an escalation queue with defined SLAs.


**Additional Skills**
* Experience with loyalty, marketing automation, or campaign management platforms.
* Familiarity with restaurant technology — POS systems, online ordering, middleware integrations.
* Experience supporting multi\-tenant SaaS where a single defect can affect many customer brands simultaneously.


**Professional Skills**
* Excellent written communication — able to explain a technical root cause clearly to a non\-technical audience, and to draft customer\-facing explanations that are accurate and appropriately scoped.
* Strong incident communication skills — able to keep stakeholders aligned during high\-pressure events.
* Sound judgment under ambiguity — able to decide independently whether an alert is genuine, when to escalate, and when to act, often outside overlapping working hours.
* Strong organizational and documentation skills; proven ability to reduce friction between teams.
* Reliability and consistency in recurring operational duties.
* Customer\-focused with a commitment to continuous improvement and measurable outcomes.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience preferred.


**Interview Process**
* Interview \#1: Phone Screen with Talent Acquisition Team
* Interview \#2: Video interview with the Technical Teams (via MS Teams/F2F)
* Interview \#3: Video interview with the Hiring Manager (via MS Teams/F2F)


 PAR is proud to provide equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability or genetics. We also provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities in accordance with applicable laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre\-employment testing, a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, or for your role at PAR, please contact accommodations@partech.com. If you’d like more information about your EEO rights as an applicant, please visit the US Department of Labor's website.

 Founded in Baltimore, MD in 1889 in a room and a cellar by 25\-year\-old Willoughby McCormick with three employees, McCormick is a global leader in flavour. With over 14,000 employees around the world and more than $6 Billion in annual sales, the Company manufactures, markets, and distributes spices, seasoning mixes, condiments and other flavourful products to the entire food industry, retail outlets, food manufactures, food service businesses and consumers.

* Strong problem solving and root cause analysis skills.

* Effective collaboration across technical and business teams.

* Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert.

title: Senior Data Platform Engineer - Snowflake
description:

 Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Data Platform Engineer specialising in Snowflake to contribute to the design, implementation, automation, security, governance, and operational excellence of an enterprise data platform. This is a Snowflake Platform Engineering role rather than a traditional Data Engineering role. The position requires strong hands\-on experience administering and operating Snowflake in a production environment, together with broad exposure across the Snowflake ecosystem. The role combines senior technical expertise, platform engineering, leadership, and strategic contribution. Role Focus The primary focus of this role will be on: Snowflake platform engineering and administration Snowflake security and access management Compute and warehouse management Snowflake Shares Identity integration and access controls Platform automation and Infrastructure as Code CI/CD and DevOps practices Monitoring and observability Snowflake cost optimisation Performance tuning and platform optimisation Platform governance and compliance Disaster recovery and business continuity Reusable platform patterns and modules Technical leadership and contribution to platform strategy ETL and data pipeline development are not core requirements for this role. However, candidates should understand data engineering practices and ideally have experience supporting or working alongside Data Engineering teams. Key Responsibilities Design and implement platform automation for Snowflake resource provisioning, configuration, and lifecycle management using Infrastructure as Code, particularly Terraform. Architect and maintain CI/CD pipelines for Snowflake infrastructure and configuration deployments using GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps. Develop comprehensive monitoring and alerting frameworks using Snowflake\-native tools. title: Global IT Configuration Engineer Manager
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.
   

  

 To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 As an Engineering Manager on BCG's CT GenAI Portfolio, you will serve as the technical and operational lead for enterprise GenAI platform delivery — owning integration architecture, release governance, vendor management, and security oversight — while working with the team of engineers, product analysts, and partnering with global stakeholders to translate BCG's AI strategy into scalable, enterprise\-ready solutions.
   

  

**Release Management:** 
 Own end\-to\-end release governance for the enterprise GenAI platform, risk assessments, deployment readiness, and coordination of release cycles across engineering, security, legal, and business teams.
   

  

**Integration Architecture \& Oversight:** 
 Define and govern the integration framework for the GenAI platform, including MCP (Model Context Protocol) architecture, platform interoperability standards, and onboarding design principles — ensuring scalable, secure, and consistent enterprise adoption across BCG.
   

  

**Stakeholder Collaboration:** 
 Partner with Product, Security, Legal, and business leaders across CT GenAI and the broader firm to translate BCG's AI strategy into platform\-wide, scalable solutions aligned with enterprise standards.
   

  

**Vendor \& Security Management:** 
 Lead architecture and security reviews, manage third\-party vendor relationships, and ensure all integrations meet BCG's enterprise compliance, audit, and quality standards.
   

  

**GenAI Capability Enablement:** 
 Stay current on GenAI platform developments, new model releases, and emerging integration patterns — acting as an evangelist for capabilities that should be prioritized for BCG's AI roadmap.
   

  

**Documentation \& Governance:** 
 Create clear specification documents for platform modifications, integration designs, and new capability additions, maintaining robust audit trails and governance processes.
   

  

**Team Leadership \& Support Operations:** 
 Support and manage L2 and L3 GenAI engineering teams, providing technical guidance, overseeing incident escalation and resolution, ensuring SLA adherence, and driving continuous improvement in platform operations and support quality.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, or a related field, with 7\+ years of experience in enterprise platform engineering, technical program management, or integration architecture.
* Strong understanding of enterprise integration patterns, APIs, and platform architecture — including familiarity with AI/GenAI platforms and MCP (Model Context Protocol).
* Proven track record of managing complex, multi\-stakeholder release programs in large, global enterprise environments.
* Experience leading security and architecture reviews and managing vendor relationships in an enterprise technology context.
* Prior experience in a consulting, platform, or SaaS environment with exposure to enterprise\-scale AI or productivity tool implementations is strongly preferred.
* Experience developing and executing comprehensive test plans and release validation frameworks is preferred.
* Skilled in stakeholder management, with the ability to operate effectively across technical and business audiences at a global scale.
* Familiarity with GenAI trends, agentic frameworks, and enterprise AI adoption patterns is preferred.
* Experience working in agile teams and applying agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban, or SAFe), including sprint planning, backlog management, and cross\-functional agile ceremonies; familiarity with agile delivery practices in an enterprise platform or engineering context is preferred.


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

* Engineers within the CT GenAI Portfolio, including integration and platform squads.
* Product, Security, Legal, and Procurement stakeholders across CT GenAI and the broader BCG


 firm.
   

  

* Third\-party GenAI vendors and platform partners.
* QA and release validation teams for platform enhancements and new capability rollouts.


 Additional info
   

  

 At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in\-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
   

  

 For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
   

  

 We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Engineering Manager- Forward Deployed
description:
**Company: Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs, Gurgaon**




  





 Deutsche Telekom Digital Labs is the behind\-the\-scenes powerhouse that fuels Deutsche Telekom’s passion \& commitment to cutting edge innovation \& out of the world customer experience. We createcompelling digital propositions for the worlds’ largest Telekom giant by building scalable and agile platforms to provide the best of digital experience to Deutsche Telekom customers across Europe.
 



 We aim to bring all the Deutsche Telekom customers onto our digital products by simplifying the experience. This includes innovative approaches to allow the user to explore compelling propositions, recommend most suitable services based on micro segmentation and so on.
 



 You ask what’s in it for you? We say,
 


* An opportunity to build digital products from scratch (literally from scratch!) for one of the leadingEuropean telecoms (Deutsche Telekom) using latest technologies \& on cloud native platforms.
* Enhanced customer experience, convergence, and increased business productivity, continuouslyinvesting into entrepreneurial value creation projects to build agility and cross functional teams in order to steer innovative business models.



 We are agile and focused on the overall makeup of the team. We believe that with the right team \- anything is possible. If you’re looking for an environment that’s fun and friendly but incredibly fast\-paced; a placewhere we measure the time between releases in days; a place where our focus begins and ends at the consumer \- join us!
 



  





**Role: Engineering Manager — Forward Deployed**




  





**Why this role exists:** 




  





 OneBot deflects contact\-center volume for Deutsche Telekom across nine European markets. The platform strategy has moved from building a single bot we own to running the harness that routes across best\-of\-breed dialog engines — Parloa, ElevenLabs, Wonderful, Decagon and OneBot — with a shared context layer beneath.
 



 That split creates two genuinely different engineering jobs. Three PODs build reusable capability: the Router, the Harness capabilities, and the Stability and Acceleration platform. This POD does not build capability. It owns the delivery of use cases inside the NatCos — getting engines live market by market, integrating APIs from systems we do not control, and clearing the business, security and procurement barriers that stand between a working capability and a customer being served by it.
 



 Historically that work was squeezed between platform priorities and NatCo deadlines, with no single owner. The result was repeated: multiple divergent integration patterns with vendors, per\-country workarounds, and platform features paused mid\-build. This role exists to own the outcome — and to own it without fragmenting the platform.
 



**Delivery ownership:** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end delivery of NatCo use cases: from requirement through integration, security clearance, launch and post\-launch quality.
* Hold the launch date. Sequence work across your squads, surface dependencies on the capability PODs early, and escalate rather than absorb.
* Own post\-launch outcomes, not just go\-live — deflection, containment and customer experience are yours after the switch is flipped.



  





**Partners and vendors** 



* Run technology and dialog\-engine partners as delivery partners: onboarding under IT guidelines with defined entry and exit criteria, integration milestones, and SLAs that hold.
* Be the single technical point of contact partners escalate to, and the person who holds them to commitments.



  





**Stakeholders, security and compliance** 



* Work with NatCo business owners, product, PSA, security, privacy and procurement to clear the non\-engineering blockers that stall AI launches.
* Drive security and privacy review to a decision — anticipate what reviewers will ask and bring it before they ask.



  





**People and team** 



* Line\-manage the Forward Deployed Engineers and squad leads: hiring, growth, performance, and building the FDE career path.
* Build a team that is credible in front of a customer and in a code review — deploy engineers into markets without losing their engineering depth.



  





**Platform discipline** 



* Push fixes and patterns discovered in the field back upstream into the owning capability POD, rather than solving them locally.
* Say no to the fast local workaround. Protecting one implementation across nine markets is part of the job, not a constraint on it.



  





**Must\-have skills and experience:** 




  




* **Experience.** 
 10\+ years in software engineering, including 3\+ years managing engineers with hiring and performance ownership.
* **Hands\-on integration depth.** 
 You have personally shipped production integrations against enterprise APIs — REST and event\-driven — in Java, Python or equivalent. You can read the code your team writes and review a design.
* **Customer\-facing delivery.** 
 You have owned delivery in front of a customer, a partner or an internal business unit, where the commitment was yours and the systems were not.
* **Vendor management.** 
 Onboarding and managing technology partners: commercial and technical entry criteria, integration milestones, SLA enforcement, and a defined exit.
* **Security and compliance fluency.** 
 You have taken a product through enterprise security, privacy and procurement review — PSA, DPIA, pen\-test remediation or the equivalent — and know how to shorten it.
* **Multi\-market rollout.** 
 Rolling the same platform into multiple markets, tenants or customers, and holding one implementation while doing it.
* **AI systems literacy.** 
 Working knowledge of how modern LLM applications are built and operated: prompts and operating procedures, tool calling and MCP, RAG, evaluation, and voice pipelines including STT, TTS, endpointing and barge\-in. Enough to hold an architectural line in a partner conversation — you are not expected to invent the architecture.
* **Ways of working.** 
 Comfortable operating across time zones with European stakeholders, with regular travel to markets.



  





**Nice to have:** 




  




* Telecommunications or contact\-center domain experience — IVR, CCaaS, routing, agent desktop.
* A forward\-deployed or solutions\-engineering background, where engineers are embedded in the customer's environment to deliver an outcome.



  





**What this role is not:** 




  





**Not a programme or project manager.** 
 The POD has a dedicated TPM who owns programme mechanics, cross\-POD dependencies and reporting. This role owns the engineering team and the outcome.
 



**Not an individual\-contributor architect.** 
 Engineers report to you. People leadership is a first\-class part of the job, not an overhead on it.

Our proprietary platforms handle millions of shipments daily across 18,000\+ pin codes, generating vast volumes of multi\-modal, spatial, operational, and conversational data.  s, you will hold the architectural blueprint and operational authority for Delhivery’s AI ecosystem. * **Systems\-First Pragmat**

* **Cross\-Functional Influe**

**CTM Senior Manager – Application Security**
**Overview**
 As part of our Cyber Security team, you will help secure applications and platforms while ensuring seamless development, build, and deployment capabilities. You will be responsible for designing secure software by identifying security use cases during the design and development stages, including emerging risks from AI/ML\-enabled applications. You will work closely with DevOps, architects, developers, and QA teams to build highly reliable and secure products. You will also coach development teams on building a strong security culture and provide recommendations on vulnerabilities, secure development practices, and the responsible adoption of AI\-driven technologies.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for a Senior Manager – Application Security \& DevSecOps to lead high\-impact application security engagements for enterprise clients. You will drive delivery, mentor teams, expand client relationships, and shape practice offerings across Secure SDLC, DevSecOps, Cloud Security, Threat Modeling, and AI/ML security.
   

  

 This role involves enabling organizations to securely adopt GenAI and AI\-driven solutions, ensuring risks are effectively managed while supporting innovation. This is a client\-facing leadership role requiring both strong technical depth and executive\-level communication.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Client Delivery \& Leadership**
* Lead end\-to\-end application security assessments (SAST/DAST/SCA, penetration testing, secure code review, threat modeling).
* Design and implement Secure SDLC frameworks for Agile/DevOps environments.
* Advise CISOs and CTOs on application security strategy, roadmaps, and ROI.
* Manage large multi\-workstream engagements.
* Advise clients on secure adoption of AI/ML and GenAI solutions, including risk assessments, governance, and secure enterprise integration.
* Lead client\-facing engagements to assess and secure AI/ML applications, providing strategic direction on risk management, governance, and mitigation of vulnerabilities such as prompt injection and data exposure.


**Practice Development**
* Develop proprietary methodologies, accelerators, and IP in AppSec (e.g., AI\-driven secure coding, intelligent vulnerability prioritization, zero\-trust application architecture).
* Contribute to thought leadership — whitepapers, webinars, conference talks (Black Hat, RSA, OWASP).
* Support proposal development and deal closure for strategic pursuits.
* Build and enhance AI security offerings, including GenAI security frameworks and AI risk governance models.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Mentor and performance\-manage a team of 20–25 consultants (Managers, Seniors, Analysts).
* Build high\-performing, diverse teams with a focus on technical excellence and client empathy.
* Drive utilization, training, and career development.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Experience building enterprise\-scale AppSec and DevSecOps programs from the ground up.
* Strong understanding of AI/ML and GenAI technologies and their application in enterprise environments.
* Knowledge of AI/ML security risks (model poisoning, prompt injection, data leakage, adversarial attacks) and mitigation techniques.
* Familiarity with secure AI adoption practices, including governance, model lifecycle security, and responsible AI principles.

title: Software Development Engineer III
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**Introduction To The Team**
 Expedia Global Payments (EGP) is looking for top engineering talent to help drive the development of our payments platform, seamlessly roll out new payments methods, and to continuously raise the bar on our operational excellence and engineering practices. Our services are the nexus of a globally distributed system that spans many organizations. Our roadmap is deep and contains several innovative programs designed to make our services fault tolerant, reduce the cost of payment processing, and improve customer experience. This includes compensating for downstream services that are not in Expedia's control. We are also looking to use cloud computing (AWS) to further solidify our infrastructure. This opportunity presents you with great technical challenges and the ability to have a tremendous business impact. We do this accurately and at scale, processing over $100 billion payments in 60\+ currencies in over 155 countries every year across diverse payment options.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Design and build end\-to\-end backend solutions for Payments, that are scalable, resilient, and performant.
* Own and evolve core payment services and workflows, including payment session lifecycle, payment\-method orchestration, and downstream service integrations.
* Build and enhance backend APIs and service interfaces using Kotlin/Java and modern service frameworks, with strong emphasis on clean contracts, backward compatibility, and operational reliability.
* Develop and support GraphQL, gRPC, and REST\-based integrations that power payment experiences across multiple Expedia Group brands and checkout surfaces.
* Contribute to distributed system design for high\-volume, multi\-tenant, 24x7 payment flows, balancing latency, availability, security, and maintainability.
* Build robust integrations with payment providers, internal platforms, and shared infrastructure while ensuring fault tolerance and graceful degradation.
* Take strong ownership of production systems, including monitoring, alerting, on\-call participation, incident response, and root cause resolution.
* Build and enhance observability through logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, and operational playbooks to proactively detect and prevent issues.
* Troubleshoot and resolve production issues with urgency, minimizing customer, partner, and business impact in high\-transaction environments.
* Continuously improve system reliability, deployment safety, and engineering effectiveness through CI/CD, rollback strategies, feature flags, test automation, and performance tuning.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, frontend engineers, partner teams, and platform teams to deliver reliable, intuitive, and scalable payment capabilities.
* Mentor junior engineers and drive engineering best practices across backend design, coding standards, testing, operational excellence, and incident management.
* Lead technical discussions, code reviews, architecture reviews, and design decisions across the team and broader payments ecosystem.
* Influence cross\-functional delivery and act as a subject matter expert for backend payment architecture, scalability, and service reliability.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* 6\+ years of professional software development experience with a strong focus on backend engineering using Java in production environments.
* Hands\-on experience designing and implementing backend services, including system design (with low\-level design), API contracts, and data modeling for RDBMS\-backed applications.
* Practical exposure to at least one major cloud platform (preferably AWS) and associated services for deploying, running, and monitoring backend services at scale.
* Demonstrated responsibility for owning and supporting backend components in production, including working with monitoring, logging, and alerting systems such as Datadog or Splunk.
* Familiarity with AI\-driven systems, tools, or workflows and applying AI/ML concepts to real world products in the context of backend service development, testing, or operations.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Deep expertise in Java\-based microservice development using frameworks such as Spring Boot, including experience modernizing legacy or monolithic systems into service\-oriented architectures.
* Strong RDBMS experience that goes beyond basic CRUD usage, including working with stored procedures, performance tuning, and systematically migrating database\-resident logic into application services.
* Experience building and operating large\-scale, business\-critical backend systems in a cloud environment (such as AWS), with a track record of using observability tooling to drive operational excellence and reliability.
* Demonstrated use of AI\-augmented development or operations (for example, code\-generation assistants, intelligent alerting, or anomaly detection) and the ability to safely integrate AI/ML‑enabled solutions into backend services to improve developer productivity, system stability, or customer outcomes.

 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

**About Milliman**
 Independent for over 70 years, Milliman delivers market\-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation. Through a team of professionals ranging from actuaries to clinicians, technology specialists to plan administrators, we offer unparalleled expertise in employee benefits, investment consulting, healthcare, life insurance, and financial services, and property and casualty insurance.
   

  

**Job Summary**
 Milliman is undertaking a major business transformation program to replace and modernize our HRIS, Finance, Legal, and Professional Services Automation systems. As part of the Data Enablement Team, we are seeking a Data \& Application Integration Engineer to support the integrity, quality, and migration of data throughout this transformation. This role will work alongside senior engineers and business/technical teams, contributing to data mapping, migration, validation, and integration activities to enable a smooth transition to new enterprise platforms. * Support the design, development, and implementation of application integrations under the guidance of senior team members.

**Required Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or a related field.

* Foundational experience with data analysis, data profiling, data mapping, and ETL processes.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Exposure to Azure Fabric or other cloud data platforms (Azure, AWS, or GCP).

* Familiarity with data governance or master data management (MDM) concepts.
* Interest in or coursework related to insurance, risk management, or financial services.
* Awareness of regulatory requirements related to data privacy and security.

* Demonstrated success leading and scaling engineering organizations, with skills in technical leadership,
